stories.h: Suspect, victim named in deadly Spanaway chase crash
stories.s: WSP identified the man killed as David Bauschman, 54, of Tacoma. Brody Wood, 20, of Centralia faces vehicular homicide, DUI, eluding and hit-and-run allegations after a deputy pursuit from Lakewood ended on Pacific Avenue South.

stories.h: Tacoma police give away free turkeys at Tacoma Dome today
stories.s: Drive-thru giveaway starts 11 a.m. Tuesday at the Tacoma Dome, with about 1,000 turkeys and sides. No registration, one per vehicle, and supplies are expected to run out by about 12:30 p.m.

stories.h: Former Puyallup, Lakewood officer charged in Home Depot thefts
stories.s: Pierce County prosecutors charged ex-officer Quinn Rawson, 31, with organized retail theft. He is accused of taking about $1,666 in merchandise over 16 visits to a Puyallup Home Depot between September and early November.

coming.h: Tacoma council expected to adopt 2027-28 budget
coming.s: The council is expected to adopt a two-year budget that closes a $40 million deficit, per NWPB. Check the city's meeting calendar for the exact session.

coming.h: Second Tacoma police turkey giveaway at Cheney Stadium
coming.s: Drive-thru giveaway with about 700 turkeys and sides starts 11 a.m. at Cheney Stadium. One per vehicle, no registration, first come first served.
